title: Hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic Clamp Protocol in Mice
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xzefp3e

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5~6 days prior to the experiment (refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation).

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours prior to the start of the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Infusion
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer with its tail tape-tethered at one end.

substeps.instruction: Expose and flush the intravenous catheter using saline solution.
Connect the catheter to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump.

steps.title: Conduct Basal Acclimation Period
steps.instruction: Perform a 2-hour acclimation period to measure the basal rate of whole body glucose turnover.

substeps.instruction: Infuse D-[3-³H] glucose at 0.05 µCi/min.
Collect a 30 µl plasma sample at the end of the period to measure plasma glucose, insulin, and [³H] glucose concentrations.

steps.title: Perform Hyperinsulinemic-Euglycemic Clamp
steps.instruction: Conduct a 2-hour clamp to raise plasma insulin levels and maintain euglycemia.

substeps.instruction: Administer a primed dose of human insulin (150 mU/kg body weight) followed by a continuous infusion at 2.5 mU/kg/min.
Infuse 20% dextrose at variable rates to maintain plasma glucose at basal concentrations.
Infuse [3-³H] glucose continuously at 0.1 µCi/min to estimate insulin-stimulated whole body glucose turnover rates.
Collect 10 µl plasma samples at 20, 40, 60, 70, 90, 100, 110, and 120 min to monitor plasma glucose concentrations.
Adjust glucose infusion rates based on instantaneous glucose levels to maintain euglycemia.

steps.title: Measure Organ-Specific Glucose Uptake
steps.instruction: Administer a tracer bolus and collect samples to estimate insulin-stimulated glucose uptake in individual organs.

substeps.instruction: Inject a bolus of 10 µCi of 2-deoxy-D-[1- 14 C] glucose (2-[ 14 C]DG) at 75 minutes after the start of the clamp.
Collect 10 µl plasma samples at 80, 85, 90, 100, 110, and 120 min for measurement of plasma [³H] glucose, ³H ² O, and 2-[ 14 C] DG concentrations.
Suspend 10 µl plasma samples in 20 µl distilled water (dH ² O) to create 30 µl sample solutions.

steps.title: Final Sample Collection and Tissue Harvest
steps.instruction: Collect final plasma parameters and harvest tissues at the end of the clamp (120 min).

substeps.instruction: Collect an additional 10 µl plasma sample to measure plasma insulin concentrations.
Anesthetize mice using pentobarbital.
Quickly dissect and collect skeletal muscles (gastrocnemius and quadriceps) from both hindlimbs, white and brown adipose tissues, liver, and heart.
Rapidly freeze-clamp tissues in liquid N ² and store in -80ºC freezer.

steps.title: Perform Biochemical Assay for Plasma
steps.instruction: Measure [3-³H] D-glucose, ³H ² O, and 2-[ 14 C] DG concentrations using plasma sample solutions.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 15 µl of plasma sample solutions into labeled microcentrifuge tubes.
Add 25 µl BaOH and vortex.
Add 25 µl Zn(SO) ² and vortex.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 12,000g (~14,000 rpm).

Prepare 'Non-Dry' samples: Transfer 20 µl of supernatant into a scintillation vial containing 60 µl dH ² O, vortex, add 3 ml Ultima scintillation cocktail, vortex, and measure with Beckman Coulter Scintillation Counter.

Prepare 'Dry' samples: Transfer 20 µl of supernatant into a scintillation vial, dry in a vacuum oven at room temperature overnight, add 80 µl dH ² O, vortex, add 3 ml Ultima scintillation cocktail, vortex, and measure with Beckman Coulter Scintillation Counter.
